why_the_mechanism_is_false: The transport account said the fixed model degrades in proportion to how far it must carry a
match. If that were true, accuracy at d = max_depth -- where nothing is carried -- would be
high. It is 0.27 and 0.24, indistinguishable from d = 1. The fixed model fails uniformly,
including in the case that requires no transport at all.
This is the first mode named in the frozen anticipated_failure_modes: 'the fixed model may
fail uniformly across d because it never learns the match predicate at all'. That is exactly
what happened, and it was written down before the run.

separation could have been about supervision rather than architecture. The
